rationale: Discography populator: full tracklist (14 tracks) per https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nostalgia,_Ultra, https://blonded.blog/news/frank-releases-nostalgia-ultra. Debut mixtape, self-released February 16, 2011. 14 tracks confirmed across Wikipedia, Blonded.blog, Discogs, and Excellent Music Wiki — all agree on order. 'American Wedding' features James Fauntleroy (later removed from some versions due to Eagles sample controversy). Titles stylized lowercase on original release; canonical title casing used here.
